findings.issue: `coeFn_toLp_inclusion_subOne` repeats the step `e` from `coeFn_toLp_inclusion_mulAux` (Algebra.lean:279-284): `LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.1 Lp.ker_toTemperedDistributionCLM_eq_bot` followed by `simp only [..., toLp_inclusion_zero, MemSobolev.toBesselPotentialSpace_toDistr]`, which identifies `(inclusion h hf.toBesselPotentialSpace).toLp` with an `L²` representative of `f`.

summary: The new declarations (`mulCLM`, `inclusion_injective`, `toLp_inclusion_injective`, `toLp_inclusion_zero`, the `SobolevGaugeGroup` topology) have no counterpart in Mathlib or TauCeti, but the PR clones its own `L²` plumbing in two places instead of sharing one lemma.
